verdict.rationale: Gitea is explicitly designed for self-hosting, with docs confirming easy deployment across OS/architectures (Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, Kubernetes, x86/arm64) without complex dependencies, and this is heavily corroborated by numerous independent hands-on community reports of running Gitea in production (single binary, Docker, low RAM footprint, VPS deployments, migrations from GitLab/Gogs) across small teams and personal projects. Missing for 10: some community reports note documentation gaps, backup/restore weaknesses, and scaling friction that mildly complicate the self-hosting story at larger scale.
